people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.
translations.bsb: Then a great cry will go out over all the land of Egypt. Such an outcry has never been heard before and will never be heard again.
translations.kjv: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
translations.asv: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there hath not been, nor shall be any more.
